page.notes: Two parallel columns: Greek left, Latin right; the Latin is printed as one passage beside the Greek lines, and the Greek is read line by line where legible. Greek lines in the paragraph beginning "Legem hanc" are italic and too small to read letter by letter; they are marked illegible with approximate letter counts. The inline Greek in the Menander citation is only partly legible. Doubtful readings: "sit" in "in Vrbem sit transductus" (could be fit); "αὑτῷ" and "Ἐξῆναι" in the left column; "Chrysside" (long s and i/d are faint); "st" in the last line (could be est). No catchword. The mark "S" at lower right is a gathering signature. Hyphenated line ends were joined: Legi-bus, Athenien-sibus, commi-grare, volu-erit, Athenien-sibus.
